entity.name: Black Dragon Foundation
entity.description: The Black Dragon Foundation builds drgnx, a native code editor written in Rust with agents at the centre of the work, in the open.

projects.name: drgnx
projects.description: A native code editor written in Rust, with agents at the centre of the work. Its goals: agents that use the same commands as people, in a sandbox, with any model; huge projects and huge files; a multi-window workbench; extensibility to the core through one extension API (WebAssembly components and Luau); and a small, measured resource footprint. It is built around an agent hub, code search, a workbench model and a native windowing shell that already exist; the text core, editor view and extension runtime are new. Status: early, foundations stage.
